description: Implementation of a test Git filter protocol version 2, supporting capabilities like clean and smudge, with special test cases for delays, errors, and write failures.

methods.name: str_or_null
methods.description: Returns the input string or '(null)' if the input is NULL.

methods.name: rot13
methods.description: Applies ROT13 cipher to the input string.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Extracts the value for a given key from a 'key=value' string, dies on error.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a 'key=value' line and returns the value, or NULL on EOF.

methods.name: assert_remote_capability
methods.description: Checks if a capability is present in the remote capabilities set.

methods.name: read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the peer and asserts required capabilities.

methods.name: check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Verifies local capabilities against remote and sends supported capabilities.

methods.name: free_delay_entries
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for delay entries.

methods.name: add_delay_entry
methods.description: Adds a delay entry for a pathname with specified count and requested status.

methods.name: reply_list_available_blobs_cmd
methods.description: Handles the list_available_blobs command, responding with delayed or available blobs.

methods.name: command_loop
methods.description: Main loop processing commands from the peer, handling different filter operations.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Performs initial handshake to establish protocol version.

methods.name: cmd__rot13_filter
methods.description: Main entry point for the rot13-filter command, parsing options, initializing, and running the filter.
